preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'review_batch'::regclass AND conname = 'ck_review_batch_status'

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review_batch DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_batch_status; ALTER TABLE review_batch ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_batch_status CHECK (status IN ('AWAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED'));
